others: the amount due from the insurer under (tprai-recovery.l4)
the amount still enforceable against the insured under (tprai-recovery.l4)
the condition binds the transferred rights under (tprai-recovery.l4)
the last day to provide information under (tprai-information.l4)
the last day to serve a list of documents under (tprai-information.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 1, 4-7 (event as input), 8, 9(3)-(6), 10, 14(1), (6)-(7), 15, 16, Sch 1 paras 1-4, Sch 3 paras 1, 3 of the revised text as at 4 January 2024. Left out on purpose: declarations (ss 2-3), limitation (s 12), jurisdiction (s 13), s 14(2)-(3), avoidance (s 17), foreign elements, regulation-making powers, Schs 2 and 4.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 97 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); none failed. Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 1(1): relevant on or before the day the liability is incurred is route (a); (b)-only events need the liability strictly first.
forks.F2: s 6(1): rights transfer only if the liability stays with the body and the arrangement binds the third party.
forks.F3: ss 8, 10: lesser of the two liabilities, less set-off, not below 0.
forks.F4: s 14(6)-(7): insolvency shortfall counts only if an FSCS claim was made when eligible, net of FSCS payments; fund-limit shortfall counts.
forks.F5: s 9: notify-a-claim is not information or assistance; prior discharge binds only marine non-personal-injury liabilities.
forks.F6: 28 days beginning with receipt end on receipt + 27.
forks.F7: Lost Schedule paragraph numbers: printed order paras 1-7.
